description: Generates 1 to 5 post drafts about a topic using a content formula (auto, or an id from list_formulas), the account persona and material, optional reference context (up to 8,000 characters) and a quality level (fast, standard, premium). Nothing is published or queued. The result carries rule_violations against the account's content_rules. Applies when the user wants drafts to read, edit or choose from.

formula.description: auto or a formula id from list_formulas

name: generate_posts
title: Generate post drafts
